title: GateKit's one settings file (gatekit.json)
description: Where things are and how GateKit behaves; each value may also come from an environment variable (CopySettings). Paths are absolute or relative to the file's folder. `home`, `seFork` and `toolkit` are the locations of the one home (docs/design/home.md).

about.description: What this file is for, in words: a field, not a comment.

home.description: The home folder: databases, tools, builds, state, caches.

seFork.description: The checkout of GateKit's Script Extender fork.

toolkit.description: The checkout of the toolkit itself.

profile.description: The real profile of the installed game (GATEKIT_PROFILE).

instances.description: The folder of the game copies (GATEKIT_INSTANCES).

state.description: The state folder of the copies (GATEKIT_STATE).

scriptExtender.description: A Script Extender build folder, or `stock` (GATEKIT_SE).

startTimeout.description: Seconds to the bridge's first heartbeat (GATEKIT_START_TIMEOUT).

bridge.description: The folder of the bridge mods (GATEKIT_BRIDGE).

instance.description: The game copy used when none is named (GATEKIT_INSTANCE).
